independent_verdict: One imposed winding quantum overcomes the original closing load on both held sharp-front geometries. The finite exit forces survive an independent original-field energy integration. The nearly exhausted phase-biased drain at radius 1 and the fast, depleted core at both radii lie outside the calibrated conversion front. These results do not establish a stable, freely released crystalline opening or physical free fall.

interpretation.force: Net force equals the matched negative closing load plus the signed change of two-sided carrier force at the same bias. The azimuthal sector is N-symmetric on this axisymmetric held order.
interpretation.force_threshold: One quantum is the smallest allowed circulation overcoming the closing load. No tested integer balances either held reference shape. Two quanta weaken the support. No continuous fit or release.

interpretation.speed: Coherent hydrodynamic long-wave sound speed c=n². No instability verdict from a large near-core Mach number. Normal flow separately exceeds the existing front calibration.
interpretation.material: Unreleased collar; changes in local crystal order tested through one-sided work. Static ansatz supplies no information about dynamical radiation, sheet splitting, or preparation of an isolated vortex.
